Futures is a different story. I do go short futures. Most people do not understand how the stock market works. Short selling is very important. When you buy a stock much of the time you are buying from a short seller. If the short seller was not there you would have to pay a higher price for the shares you bought. In many cases without a short seller, there would be no stock to buy. The spread between the bid and the ask would be massive without short selling.

Of course, the short seller is hoping the price goes down while you are hoping the price goes up. That is what true capitalism is all about. I agree that there are bad actors but that does not invalidate capitalism. Stocks do not fall because short-sellers are selling. Stocks fall because there are no more buyers at that price level. Short sellers almost NEVER chase the price down. They enter the position and wait for the price to drop on its own. They are betting that the buyers are finished buying at that price level.
